mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO request_source_snapshot (run_id, owner_type, owner_key, declaration_fingerprint, source_mode, processing_source_count, unavailable_source_count) VALUES (#{runId}, #{owner.ownerType}, #{owner.ownerKey}, #{fingerprint}, #{sources.mode}, #{sources.processingSourceCount}, #{sources.unavailableSourceCount})

INSERT INTO request_source_snapshot_item (run_id, ordinal, material_id, version_id, revision_id, kind, display_name, scope_type, scope_key, source_state, source_origin, has_text, has_visual, pinned, counts_as_processing_source) VALUES (#{runId}, #{ordinal}, #{source.materialId}, #{source.versionId}, #{source.revisionId}, #{source.kind}, #{source.displayName}, #{source.scopeType}, #{source.scopeKey}, #{source.state}, #{source.origin}, #{source.hasText}, #{source.hasVisual}, #{source.pinned}, #{source.countsAsProcessingSource})
mapper.select: SELECT run_id, declaration_fingerprint, source_mode, processing_source_count, unavailable_source_count FROM request_source_snapshot WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND owner_type = #{owner.ownerType} AND owner_key = #{owner.ownerKey}

SELECT item.ordinal, item.material_id, item.version_id, item.revision_id, item.kind, item.display_name, item.scope_type, item.scope_key, item.source_state AS state, item.source_origin AS origin, item.has_text, item.has_visual, item.pinned, item.counts_as_processing_source FROM request_source_snapshot_item item JOIN request_source_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.run_id = item.run_id WHERE item.run_id = #{runId} AND snapshot.owner_type = #{owner.ownerType} AND snapshot.owner_key = #{owner.ownerKey} ORDER BY item.ordinal
